initiatives.name: Really Really Free Market - Santa Cruz
initiatives.description: Monthly free market in Santa Cruz held the second Sunday at SubRosa, 703 Pacific Ave. Nothing is bought, sold or traded; people bring and take items.

initiatives.name: SubRosa
initiatives.description: Collectively run anarchist community space at 703 Pacific Ave, Santa Cruz. Hosts events, classes, meetings and an anarchist lending library.

initiatives.name: Santa Cruz Hub for Sustainable Living
initiatives.description: A constellation of mutual aid projects supporting skill-sharing and sustainable communities since 1994. The Hub hosts multiple initiatives including The Bike Church (community bike shop), The Fábrica (textile arts workspace), Hard Core Compost, PedX Courier & Cargo, and Tenant Sanctuary, while fostering interconnected networks of community care and ecological stewardship.

initiatives.name: Tenant Sanctuary
initiatives.description: A tenant rights education project providing direct support and mutual aid through rights counseling, education, and community organizing. They offer in-person, phone, and email counseling on issues like rent increases, evictions, deposits, and habitability while building tenant power through collective knowledge and solidarity.

initiatives.name: Homeless United for Friendship and Freedom (HUFF)
initiatives.description: Santa Cruz homeless rights group. Meets Thursdays at SubRosa, documents police actions against encampments, and runs a radio show on Free Radio Santa Cruz.

initiatives.name: Santa Cruz Welcoming Network
initiatives.description: Volunteer-run group in Santa Cruz County, active since 2019, that helps asylum seekers and refugees resettle. Has over 100 volunteers.

initiatives.name: SURJ Santa Cruz County
initiatives.description: Santa Cruz County chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice. Organizes white people for racial justice through events, book circles, and donations to local BIPOC-led groups.

initiatives.name: Santa Cruz Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Shares free vegan meals and survival gear in downtown Santa Cruz on weekends, noon to 3pm, and campaigns for shelter for unhoused people.
